scope.mapping: Exactly one record per company-bindings record, preserving order, id, target, clone, name, kind, category, file, original_picture, reference, source and exports. Clone is the scoped company target; id and target remain the original generic IDs as pinned.
scope.status: All eleven companies visually approved, exported and mechanically bound under preserve-hired-v2. In-game QA pending.

art_rules.palette_policy: Hex swatches are proposed object-material finishes, not canonical company colors or national heraldry. No blanket gold/cobalt palette; small brass/bronze only where the actual component warrants it.
art_rules.identity_policy: These are generic category companies scoped jointly to ERI/EYR/AVI, not eleven newly named lore corporations. Invent no founder, heraldic lineage, national identity or manufacturer trademark. No flags are needed; do not add one.
art_rules.trait_policy: Depict category and supported traits, not unsupported equipment bonuses. Aircraft constructions are illustrative period product symbols, not claims of documented company models. Generic traits with only random/AI fields add no equipment modifier.
art_rules.composition: Create one distinct painted Hearts of Iron IV / Equestria at War company emblem for a 64x64 RGBA game icon. Square composition, transparent exterior, compact bold silhouette with a small clear margin; one dominant object assembly and at most two supporting motifs. Period mechanical materials, restrained painted highlights and readable value separation. No humans or hands, animals, national heraldry, flags, crowns, lilies, invented logos, letters, pseudo-text, blank documents, decorative badge frame, laurel wreath, ribbons or opaque background. Do not outline everything in gold. The company name identifies the target only and must not appear as lettering.
art_rules.reference_review: Native definitions and trait effects inspected. Original sprite references copied exactly from company-bindings; sprite pixels were not visually reviewed for this sidecar.
art_rules.scope_preservation: All eleven separate company targets remain required. The four aircraft companies use different silhouettes, not palette-swapped copies. No global generic sprite replacement is implied.
